definitions.gloss: transformation, transfiguration, dramatic change in appearance
definitions.explanation: A striking change in outward appearance or visible character. Often used for places, people, or things that have changed so dramatically they are almost unrecognizable. Emphasizes the visual or external aspect of change.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}が{変貌|へんぼう}を{遂|と}げた。
{再開発|さいかいはつ}で{駅前|えきまえ}が{大|おお}きく{変貌|へんぼう}した。
examples.english: The area in front of the station was dramatically transformed by redevelopment.

examples.japanese: かつての{静|しず}かな{漁村|ぎょそん}は、{観光地|かんこうち}として{変貌|へんぼう}を{遂|と}げ、{今|いま}では{多|おお}くの{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}で{賑|にぎ}わっている。
examples.english: The once-quiet fishing village has transformed into a tourist destination and is now bustling with travelers.

notes:
USAGE:
{変貌|へんぼう} focuses on visible, outward change — how something looks or appears. It is commonly paired with を{遂|と}げる (to accomplish/undergo) in the set phrase {変貌|へんぼう}を{遂|と}げる. Compared to {変容|へんよう} (qualitative, deep transformation) and {変化|へんか} (general change), {変貌|へんぼう} emphasizes the dramatic visual difference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変貌|へんぼう}を{遂|と}げる: to undergo a transformation
- {大|おお}きく{変貌|へんぼう}する: to be dramatically transformed
- {街|まち}の{変貌|へんぼう}: transformation of a town
- {著|いちじる}しい{変貌|へんぼう}: remarkable transformation
